prompt: This weekend you have revision to do, a family lunch, and a friend's match you want to watch. Which planning approach is most realistic?

options.text: List everything and just work until you drop on Sunday night
Cancel all the social plans and revise for the whole weekend
Block a specific time for each commitment, including breaks, and check the plan fits the hours available
Start with whichever you feel like and hope the rest fits around it

explanation: Putting each commitment into a real time slot, breaks included, shows whether the weekend actually fits — and lets you adjust calmly in advance instead of running out of time.
